findings.fix: Remove `@[expose, simps]` from all five definitions and manually add their projection lemmas, e.g., `lemma proton_massNumber : proton.massNumber = 1 := (rfl)`.

findings.issue: The `DensityProfile.hardSphere`, `.gaussian`, and `.woodsSaxon` instances use `@[expose]` to compensate for missing API (to allow `@[simps]` to work without module boundary errors).

summary: The PR correctly hides the bodies of the general definitions behind `_def` lemmas, but it still uses `@[expose]` on the concrete structure instances to allow `@[simps]` to work. Replace `@[expose, simps]` on these bundled instances with manually written field projection lemmas proved by `:= (rfl)` to satisfy the requirement to keep bodies unexposed.
